## Change classification

- [ ] Editorial — meaning and expected behavior do not change
- [ ] Clarification — existing meaning becomes clearer without changing responsibility or outcome
- [ ] Additive — compatible guidance or capability is added
- [ ] Normative — required behavior, authority, responsibility, gate, audit, or conformance changes
- [ ] Breaking — existing adopters, artifacts, tools, or conformance claims may need to change
